phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Smartphone Application Processor (SoC) Package consisting of a silicon die integrated within a multi-layer substrate with embedded passive components, assembled with wire or flip-chip bonding, and housed in a protective mold or ceramic enclosure.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The dominant industry-standard for smartphone SoC packaging in 2024 is organic laminate-based packages with flip-chip bonding and TSV (Through-Silicon Via) technology. These packages integrate the die with multiple substrate layers and passive components, enabling high-speed signal integrity and thermal performance essential for mobile processors.
